title: Aromatic Chewy Indian Morbier Lassi
description: A unique and romantic Indian dish featuring morbier cheese, this lassi is salty, chewy, and perfect for a special occasion. It is also Buddhist-temple-friendly and made using mushimono-steam method.
instructions: In a large pot, bring the water to a boil and then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Add the morbier cheese to the pot and let it melt, stirring occasionally.
In a blender, combine the yogurt, salt, ginger, cumin seeds, and coriander seeds, and blend until smooth.
Add the melted cheese to the blender and blend until well combined.
Strain the mixture into a large bowl to remove any excess cheese curds.
Add the honey to the bowl and stir until dissolved.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Cover the bowl with a lid and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, give the mixture a good stir and pour into individual glasses.
Serve chilled and garnished with a sprinkle of cumin seeds and coriander seeds.
